task: Predict the cell voltage of one Chen2020 LG M50 cell through a constant-current discharge, rest and charge protocol.

inputs.name: until_voltage
inputs.quantity: voltage cutoff that ends a step early

conventions: c_rate is positive. The step kind sets the direction, with positive current for discharge and negative current for charge.
Current is the C-rate times the parameter set's nominal capacity of 5 A.h.
Times are seconds from the start of the experiment; temperatures are kelvin.

model.name: PyBaMM single particle model (SPM) with the Chen2020 parameter set
assumptions: No aging, mechanics, lithium plating or pack control.
The single particle model's reduced electrolyte transport.
Cutoffs must lie within the Chen2020 voltage limits of 2.5 to 4.2 V. The reference case ran without a cutoff.

implementation.tool: PyBaMM with the IDAKLU solver of pybammsolvers 0.10.0

verifier.acceptance: This fixture requires cell voltage to move by less than 5 mV when solver tolerances tighten and when the mesh doubles. In the reference case, voltage moved by about 1 µV and 2.17 mV, respectively.
